text:
anya: quick check: i'm prototyping a runtime/compile split for routing hints. idea is push cheap 'tenant hint' evaluation into the edge runtime to reduce probe fanout, and keep the heavy policy compiler for offline precomputation. goal: cut average probe count by ~30% for high-qps tenants :chart_with_downwards_trend:
lex: interesting. can you sketch the fast-path API we'd add to the runtime?
anya: yeah — runtime would expose evaluate_hint(hint_blob) => {allow_routes, soft_penalties}. hint_blob is tiny (tenant id, model_family, latency_sla, region_pref). decision must be <=1ms. heavy policy compiler still emits route-compat map for full fallback graph.
samir: +1 on latency goals but worried about divergence. how do we keep runtime hints consistent with compiled policy?
anya: plan: compiler emits a signed versioned snapshot. runtime caches snapshot and validates hint decisions against snapshot hashes periodically. mismatch => fallback to conservative admit. snapshot update cadence configurable.
julie: what about model-variant compatibility? runtime doesn't have full model shape info.
lex: runtime hints should only do coarse filtering (region, tier, simple capacity checks). anything variant-specific needs compiler authority. sequence: runtime filters -> probe small candidate set -> compiled policy does final adjudication.
anya: exactly. runtime will tag candidates with reason codes so ops can trace why probe fanout reduced. e.g., reason=region_pref|tier_block|cache_hit.
samir: rollout plan? safe to flip globally?
anya: propose canary: 1) enable runtime hints for small percentage of traffic on dev pool 2) enable for subset of tenants (low-risk) with telemetry gated 3) expand if regressions <0.5% error & latency SLO stable.
ops-bot: deploy-check: canary group must have trace sampling of 100% and eval-runbook attached.
lex: telemetry — what metrics to watch?
anya: key: probe_count_per_request, avg_probe_latency, route_miss_rate (runtime-filtered but later admitted by compiler), fallback_rate, p50/p95 latency for requests hitting hint path. also correlated cost-per-token.
julie: edge-case: if snapshot update lags, runtime might overfilter and increase fallback to slower models in other regions -> higher cost. need TTL-based conservative windows.
samir: agree. also protect against oscillation: if runtime toggles filter aggressively, we'll see probe_count thrash. add hysteresis + min-window.
lex: other ops concerns: debugging. how will oncall inspect a bad decision?
anya: runtime will log decision_signature + snapshot_version + reason_codes. add a /debug/route_lookup API that returns the exact evaluation path (fast-filter decisions + compiled fallback chain). Protected to internal only.
julie: security: signed snapshots okay, but who rotates keys? ops team will manage KMS keys and rotation policy. add an emergency kill-switch to disable runtime hints.
samir: sim tests? we should run the new flow in shadow mode for a week with real traffic and compare probe_count/latency/cost.
anya: yep — shadow mode planned: runtime emits what-it-would-have-filtered but still lets probes run. next: small-scale canary where the runtime actually prunes.
lex: sounds good. two small asks: 1) add explicit metric for "false_filter" where runtime-filtered route ends up being the only valid compiled route (i.e., runtime incorrectly filtered all valid options) 2) white-list flag for high-risk tenants to skip runtime filters.
anya: will add both.
julie: doc note: update rollout playbook with remediation steps (kill-switch, snapshot flush, revert runtime version).
anya: ack. i'll draft an RFC with the API shape, telemetry dashboard mockups, and staged rollout plan. putting it on the calendar for architecture sync next thursday.
lex: :thumbsup: thanks anya.
samir: thanks — excited to see numbers from shadow run.
anya: one more: can we reuse existing probe-caching layer for runtime to avoid extra infra? runtime hint will reference cache keys so probes can short-circuit if KV hits. ops-bot please file infra ticket if no objections.
ops-bot: ticket created: INFRA-4821 "runtime-hint-probe-cache-integration". link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-4821
lex: nice. tiny config example for the runtime API for the RFC:
```
runtime.hints.enabled = true
runtime.hints.snapshot_ttl = "60s"
runtime.hints.hysteresis_ms = 500
runtime.hints.white_list = ["tenant:alpha", "tenant:beta"]
```

anya: perfect. i'll include that in RFC. thanks everyone.
